heroSummary: Dearborn Public Schools begins Monday, August 24, 2026, with a half day for all students. Young 5s and kindergarten stay on half days through August 27. Most Tuesdays from September through May end 90 minutes early. The tentative last day is June 10, 2027; it moves to June 11 only if the district adds an extra Eid closure in March.

customSections.label: About Dearborn Public Schools
customSections.content: Dearborn Public Schools serves nearly 20,000 students across 37 schools in 36 buildings. The district serves almost all of Dearborn and part of Dearborn Heights, and about 45% of students are English learners. The district publishes calendar materials in both English and Arabic, and the 2026–27 calendar includes districtwide Eid closures.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Dearborn Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students start Monday, August 24, 2026 on a half-day schedule. Young 5s and kindergarten continue with half days August 25–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Dearborn Public Schools in 2027, and why could it move to June 11?
calendarFaqs.a: Thursday, June 10, 2027 is the tentative last day and a half day. June 11 becomes the last day only if lunar timing requires an additional Eid closure on March 9 or March 12.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Dearborn dismiss early every Tuesday?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district lists 31 in-session Tuesdays with shortened schedules from September through May. Most are 90-minute early dismissals; January 5 has a separate secondary half-day schedule. Tuesdays that are districtwide no-school days are excluded.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is Tuesday early dismissal?
calendarFaqs.a: The common times are 2:25 p.m. for elementary schools, 1:50 p.m. for middle and K–8 schools, and 1:15 p.m. for high schools. Several schools and programs have listed exceptions.

calendarFaqs.q: Is October 23 a half day for every Dearborn student?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 23 is an elementary half day with teacher duty in the afternoon; secondary students have a full day.

calendarFaqs.q: Is January 5 a half day for every Dearborn student?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Secondary students have a half day and elementary students use the regular Tuesday early-dismissal schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families find the Arabic Dearborn calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Dearborn provides both an Arabic calendar graphic and an Arabic text version through its official calendar hub.
